headline: Nvidia's CEO was called before lawmakers over alleged ties to a Chinese spy, as 125+ UK and Canadian lawmakers urged a ban on runaway machine intelligence and Anthropic's amended S-1 warned it may be nearing 'dramatically accelerated' AI progress.

points.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was asked by three House Republican committee chairs to brief Congress behind closed doors about his reported ties to a woman accused of spying for China.
More than 125 UK and Canadian lawmakers urged a ban on runaway machine intelligence, citing new evidence that it could arrive sooner than expected.

Anthropic's amended S-1 warned it may imminently meet its Responsible Scaling Policy's definition of 'dramatically accelerated progress' from AI, as METR's independent assessment reviewed AI R&D acceleration at the company in October.
OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model it says is better at finding vulnerabilities and less likely to go rogue and hack other platforms.
Policy Gradients interviewed Ben Buchanan on the 'blue tsunami,' export controls, and American leadership on superintelligence.
The ITU's AI for Good Summit shared takeaways on real AI problems and solutions from ecosystems at the event.
